name: Aim High Academy Summer Day Camps
description_short: Summer day camps for ages 3-10 at Aim High Academy, a gymnastics and education center in East Greenwich, RI. Campers do a mix of indoor and outdoor activities (arts & crafts, games, gymnastics, adventure play) with theme-based sessions and themed Fun Fridays.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: This is an overview page linking to three programs (Summer Day Camps, Gymnastics Training Camp, School's Out Vacation Camp). It has no dates, prices or ages. The details are on the 'Learn more' pages, which were not provided.
No season year is stated. Copyright reads 2009-2026, so it is unknown whether any 2027 information has been posted.
The activities listed (arts & crafts, games, gymnastics, adventure play) are described for the School's Out Vacation Camp. They may not match the summer camp exactly.
The Gymnastics Training Camp is a single-focus program for girls only, separate from the general day camp.
